newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Man Yue share offer 10.2 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Man Yue share offer 10.2 times subscribed.

text.p: Man Yue International Holdings Ltd said in a statement on Tuesday its public offering of 55 million shares was 10.2 times subscribed.
Of the amount offered, 5.5 million shares were allotted in full on a preferential basis to its employees, it said.
The group, whose market capitalisation will amount to HK$237 million, trades a wide range of capacitors and resistors used mostly in the manufacture of consumer electronic products.

It expects to raise HK$48 million in net proceeds from the issue, of which HK$12 million would be used for the purchase of additional equity interests in Shenzhen Samxon, while HK$6 million would be used for the installation of additional machinery at the Samxon plant in the southern Chinese city.

It said HK$5 million would be for expansion and up-grading production capacity of Manyue in Shenzhen. Some HK$10 million would be for repayment of bank loans and the remaining balance of HK$15 million for additional working capital.
Dealings in the shares are expected to begin on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong on March 5.
